status: fresh, self-contained, authored synthetic prompts; no private data
answer_rule: Return a JSON object mapping each case ID to only its short final answer. No explanations.

cases.prompt: A vehicle travels 84 km at 42 km/h, then 126 km at 63 km/h. Give its average speed for the whole trip in km/h as a number only.
A price of 250 rises by 12%, then falls by 10% of the new price. Give the final price as a number only.
A bag has 4 red and 5 blue balls. Two are drawn without replacement. What is the probability of exactly one red? Give a reduced fraction.
Machine A finishes a job in 6 hours and B in 9 hours. Working together at constant rates, how many hours do they need? Give a reduced fraction.
Find the smallest positive integer n with n mod 4 = 3, n mod 7 = 5, and n mod 9 = 2. Give the integer only.
Eight measurements have mean 17 and twelve others have mean 22. What is the mean of all twenty? Give the number only.
A tank starts empty. Add 3/8 of its capacity, then 1/4 of its capacity, then drain 1/5 of its capacity. What fraction of capacity remains? Give a reduced fraction.
A 200 km trip consists of 120 km at 60 km/h and 80 km at 40 km/h. Give the average speed in km/h as a number only.
A bag has 3 red and 2 blue balls. Draw two without replacement. Given that the first ball is blue, what is the probability the second is red? Give a reduced fraction.
A sequence starts a1=2 and obeys a(n+1)=3a(n)-1. What is a4? Give the integer only.

A prize is in one of four boxes A, B, C, D. Their signs read: A says 'in B'; B says 'not in C'; C says 'in A'; D says 'not in B'. Exactly one sign is true. Which box contains the prize? Give its letter only.
Five tasks P,Q,R,S,T must obey S before Q, Q before T, T before P, and P before R. Which task is third? Give its letter only.
Exactly one of X and Y is selected. X implies Z; Z implies W. W is false. Which of X or Y must be selected? Give X or Y only.
A and B are each truth-tellers or liars. A says 'B is a liar'. B says 'A and I are the same type'. Which person tells the truth? Answer A, B, both, or neither.
Every ren is a vek. No vek is a tar. Can any ren be a tar? Answer yes or no only.
At least one of P and Q is true. P is false. Q implies R. Is R necessarily true? Answer yes or no only.
Four runners A,B,C,D finished with no ties. A finished ahead of B; D finished behind B; C finished ahead of A. Who finished last? Give one letter.
Exactly two of switches K,L,M,N are on. If K is on, L is off. If M is on, K is on. N is off. Which two switches are on? Give their letters in alphabetical order with no separator.
A rule says if the alarm sounds then the door is locked. The door is not locked. Must the alarm be silent? Answer yes or no only.
Exactly one of A and B is true. A implies C. If B is false then C is true. C is false. What are A and B? Answer TT, TF, FT, or FF in that order.

print(f(4), f(7))

else: print('even')
print(n)

What does this JavaScript print? Give the printed value exactly: const a={inner:{n:1}}; const b={...a}; b.inner.n=5; console.log(a.inner.n);
What does this JavaScript print? Give the printed value exactly: console.log((0 ?? 7) + (0 || 7));

Release log: v4 built Monday and tested Tuesday. v5 built Tuesday, tested Wednesday, and deployed Thursday. v4 was never deployed. Which version is live? Answer v4, v5, both, or neither.
The report records 13 successful checks and 2 failed checks. A third attempted check has no recorded result. Give the minimum number of successful checks consistent with the report.
Inventory note: 24 kits at opening. Receive 9. Ship 7. Reserve 5 of the remaining kits for Friday; reserved kits are still physically on hand. How many are physically on hand now? Give an integer.
Inventory note: 24 kits at opening. Receive 9. Ship 7. Reserve 5 of the remaining kits for Friday; reserved kits cannot be sold today. How many kits are available to sell today? Give an integer.

Instructions: take a backup before migrating; migrate before deploying the API; deploy the API before enabling traffic. Which operation must happen immediately before traffic if each is performed once in a valid order? Answer backup, migrate, or deploy.
An observational study finds that people using app A scored higher. It did not control for prior grades or study time. Does this establish that app A caused the higher scores? Answer yes or no only.

Policy memo: submissions received by 17:00 are reviewed that day; later submissions wait until the next business day. A submission arrives at 17:03 on Monday. Which day is its first scheduled review? Answer a weekday name.

A dashboard says 18 shipments on Tuesday. Its footnote says the Tuesday number excludes 3 pending shipments. A separate draft email says 21 shipments, apparently counting pending ones. How many completed Tuesday shipments does the dashboard report? Give an integer.
A team has 6 completed tickets and 1 ticket whose status is unrecorded. Could exactly 7 tickets be complete? Answer yes or no only.
Revision history: note A was drafted at 09:00, note B at 10:00, and note A was updated at 11:00. Which note had the most recent change? Answer A or B only.
